purpose: Track active personal practice without automatically promoting unfinished work to public Selected Works.

items.title: Stage Casting 04 — Spatial Performance Instrument

items.evidenceStatus: research scaffold exists; real-device and stage-network verification incomplete
blockers: real Vision Pro / WebXR end-to-end device proof not yet recorded
stage-network and failure fallback not yet documented
no rehearsal artifact proving the full control chain
items.nextGate: Document one verified end-to-end Vision Pro/WebXR → control → OSC/Ableton/Max-Jitter → audio/visual performance path on real hardware, including one failure fallback and one rehearsal artifact.
items.stopDoing: Do not expand demo count or write the 2026-12-04 target as a completed public credit before it happens.

items.title: Spatial Media Systems

blockers: framework breadth exceeds the amount of fully packaged cross-project evidence

items.title: Performance Control Model / Personal A/V Instrument
items.pmDecision: Support Stage Casting and finished workshop evidence; avoid growing the model as an abstract taxonomy without a live proof.

items.nextGate: Use the model to support one verified Stage Casting performance path and keep completed workshop evidence distinct from speculative research claims.
items.stopDoing: Do not add model layers that are not required by a current experiment, performance or public explanation.
